words.gloss_range: corrective and adversative pivot that redirects the discourse from completed lordship proof into a diagnosis of failed reception
words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) does not add a loose afterthought. It opens the ayah by correcting the expected response to the lordship proof of 44:8: recognition should follow, but the discourse turns instead to a group diagnosed in doubt and play. Because the particle stands first, the whole following clause is read under this corrective pressure, moving from proof architecture to reception failure. The shift also changes the audience from direct address into third-person observation, so the refusal is held up for analysis rather than simply debated. Even the clipped opening sound supports the abruptness of that turn without becoming an independent meaning.

The pronoun is not a vague mood marker: it is the subject of a nominal diagnosis, so the state of doubt and the later act of play attach to an accountable collective. The clause order matters: first the group is set before the reader, then its interior location is named, and only afterward its conduct is disclosed.

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) supplies more than a link. words.prose: {{ar:شَكٍّۢ}} ({{tr:shakkin}}) is the noun at the center of the diagnosis. Governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), it is not the direct object of a doubting verb but the state in which the group is located; the ayah first names the environment, then lets {{ar:يَلْعَبُونَ}} ({{tr:yalʿabūna}}) reveal conduct within it. Its indefinite singular form leaves the objection unnamed and diffuse, so the issue is evasive uncertainty rather than a disciplined question. As a verbal noun, it compresses doubting into an inhabitable condition. The root's split and interlock range makes the selected doubt feel like fractured conviction, while local grammar keeps the sense epistemic rather than literal piercing or fitting. After the proof of 44:8, this is not neutral inquiry: the wider doubt formula in 14:10 sharpens the challenge, and the next ayah answers the enclosed uncertainty with a manifest sign (44:10).

words.prose: {{ar:يَلْعَبُونَ}} ({{tr:yalʿabūna}}) is the ayah's final disclosure of conduct. The verb is active and plural, so the same group named by {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) performs the action; they are not merely victims of uncertainty. Its imperfect form keeps the play ongoing, and its finite shape avoids turning them into a fixed player-label. Because no object is supplied, the unseriousness remains open-ended: signs, discourse, time, and their own doubt are not narrowed to one target. The local frame after {{ar:شَكٍّۢ}} ({{tr:shakkin}}) selects culpable frivolity rather than neutral recreation, with manipulation-family pressure sharpening the sense as strategic evasion but not replacing the surface verb. The final position leaves the reader with continuing objectless play as the diagnostic residue. Wider echoes deepen the contrast: worldly life as play and diversion (6:32; 29:64), and creation explicitly denied as play (21:16; 44:38), make human play here stand against divine seriousness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The locative construction `fi shakk` and the ongoing plural verb `yalabun`.
baseline_models.mechanism: They inhabit unresolved alternatives as a field in which purposeless action can continue. Doubt and play are mutually sustaining conditions rather than two unrelated faults.

activation_trace.role: Interlocked alternatives supply the literal unresolved field that the locative construction makes inhabitable.
Aimless non-serious action supplies the ongoing practice that operates inside and prolongs that field.

changed_reading.after: They keep an unresolved field open by acting within it as though no sound end need be chosen.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The enclosure implied by `fi shakk` and the fitted-equipment branch of `shakk`.
baseline_models.mechanism: Doubt can be worn as defensive equipment: tightly fitted uncertainty absorbs the force of a serious claim, while play prevents direct engagement.

activation_trace.role: Armor fitted around a wearer supplies a material image for doubt as chosen defensive enclosure.
Non-serious action functions as the evasive behavior protected by that enclosure.

changed_reading.after: Doubt may be their protection from having to receive the claim at full seriousness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The explicit plural `hum` and plural imperfect `yalabun`, joined to a collective branch of `shakk`.
baseline_models.mechanism: Uncertainty can organize a group. Shared play rehearses and displays membership, so the verse can describe a social formation rather than an accidental collection of private doubts.

activation_trace.role: An interlocked group or ordered row supplies the collective geometry attached to the plural subject.
Repeated unserious conduct functions as the group's coordinating performance.

changed_reading.before: Several individuals happen to doubt and play.
changed_reading.after: Their doubt-play may bind them into a recognizable and mutually reinforced camp.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disclosure, discrimination, and certainty form a counter-process to interlocked alternatives. Because that process precedes `bal`, the focus doubt reads less like missing evidence and more like a maintained refusal to let disclosed distinctions settle.

activation_trace.role: Interlocked alternatives identify the focus condition that the preceding sequence should undo.
Aimless action supplies a plausible practice for keeping the unresolved condition active.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign supplies an available counterforce to obscurity.
Distinguishing two things supplies the operation opposite to keeping alternatives interlocked.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the explicit endpoint refused at the focus.

structural_cues: 44:2-7 moves from a manifest book through distinguished affairs to certainty before `bal` reverses the expected uptake in 44:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, separation, and certainty against interlock; I infer that play helps maintain the interlock. A live alternative is that play merely results from doubt rather than causing its persistence.

changed_reading.before: Their doubt may be a deficit caused by unavailable clarity.
changed_reading.after: They inhabit interlocked alternatives despite an available separating disclosure, and play helps prevent that disclosure from becoming settled certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Crisis briefly changes their avowal, but a small lifting of affliction is followed by return. The focus doubt-play therefore has a recurrent, pressure-sensitive mechanism: it pauses under exposure and resumes when pressure recedes.

Ongoing unserious conduct supplies the behavior that can stop and restart.

structural_cues: 44:10-15 moves from an approaching covering affliction to profession, partial uncovering, and predicted return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crisis, requested uncovering, limited relief, and return; I infer that the returned-to pattern includes the focus doubt-play. The alternative is a broader return to rejection without the playful mode specifically recurring.

changed_reading.before: Doubt-play is a stable intellectual and behavioral description.
changed_reading.after: Doubt-play is a reversible habit that yields under immediate pain and reconstitutes itself once relief restores room for evasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A disclosed messenger is met by turning away and by incompatible labels. Doubt is enacted as a labeling game: alternate descriptions are spoken into circulation so that the clear claim remains caught between manufactured possibilities.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Doubt as an inhabited interlock maintained by play.** `ش ك ك B001` supplies interlocked alternatives without certainty, and `ل ع ب B001` action without a sound aim. The locative `في` makes doubt an enclosing state while the imperfect verb makes play its ongoing behavior; I infer that aimless action keeps alternatives from resolving. The ayah reads their doubt as practiced suspension, not a neutral lack of evidence.
2. **Tracklessness as the social effect of play.** `ل ع ب B005` supplies wind-play and trackless places. With the ordered cosmic and revelatory sequence immediately behind it, I infer that play erases a navigable track through the signs. This exploratory reading makes their activity disorienting as well as unserious.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 44:38 explicitly transfers `لعب` from the doubters to a negation about creation. This later reversal shows that their play is not harmless mood; it imposes aimlessness on a world whose measured structure refuses that projection.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Doubt is an interlocking defense.** `ش ك ك` `B001` is uncertain alternatives, `B002` is piercing or threading one thing into another, and `B005` is an interlocked ordered row. In the following sequence the people can plead belief under the covering (`44:12`) yet turn away from a manifest messenger and supply incompatible labels, “taught” and “mad” (`44:13-14`). The branches assign doubt a structure that can thread mutually inconsistent responses together. The packet supplies the contradictions; I infer **interlocking alternatives -> insulation from any single disclosure**. `فِى شَكٍّ` reads as habitation inside a constructed defense, not passive lack of data.

2. **Play is temporal evasion.** `ل ع ب` `B001` is non-serious action without a sound aim. It is immediately reversed by the command to watch for a day (`44:10`), and the later plea (`44:12`) shows seriousness arriving only when consequence covers them. Play’s role is to consume the interval before the appointed event without orienting toward it. The packet supplies play, waiting, and forced plea; I infer **aimless use of time -> delayed recognition**. The ayah reads as a failed temporal posture, not merely amusement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Creation itself is later denied to be `لَعِب` (`44:38`), converting the people’s play into a local misfit inside a purposive system. `44:50` then names their stance with `م ر ي`’s disputing branch, confirming that the earlier doubt matured into maintained contention rather than remaining neutral uncertainty.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü dalın merkezini kesinliğin karşıtı olan zihinsel durum ve iki karşıt olasılığın dengede kalması olarak doğrular. Dişi devenin çiftleşmesine ilişkin kuşku ise bu merkezin özel bir adlandırmasıdır; dalın genel tanımına kurucu unsur olarak katılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bilgisizlikten çok karşıt seçenekler arasında kesinliğe ulaşamamayı anlatır; deveye ilişkin kullanım özel kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin genel kuşku anlamı, belirli bir konuda kuşku duyma ve kuşku uyandırma yapılarından ve deveye özgü addan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Karşıt olasılıklar eşit ağırlıkta kaldığı için bir konuda kesin bir yargıya varamama durumudur. Kuşkuya düşme, başkasında kuşku uyandırma ve devenin çiftleşmesine ilişkin özel adlandırma bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: İki karşıt olasılık dengede kaldığından kesinlik oluşmaz.
Kişi kuşkuya düşebilir veya başka biri onda kuşku uyandırabilir.
Dişi devenin çiftleşip çiftleşmediğinin bilinmemesi özel bir adla belirtilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar genel olarak kesinliğin karşıtını ve iki karşıt olasılığın zihinde eşit kalmasını bildirir. Aynı toplu kanıt, dişi devenin çiftleşmesine ilişkin belirsizliği özel bir kullanım olarak ayrıca verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü yalnızca delip geçmeyi değil, bir şeyi başka bir şeye sokmayı veya ona ekleyip birleştirmeyi de açıkça kapsar. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak geçici çerçevedeki delme ve dizme görüntüsü genel birleştirme kapsamını dışlamayacak biçimde genişletilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Delme, içeri geçirme ve bu yolla birleştirme çekirdektedir; yalnızca araçla yapılan yaralama olarak sınırlandırılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel sokma ve birleştirme anlamı, kargı, yaprak, balta ve taşıma kafesiyle kurulan özel yapılardan ayrı gösterilir; hiçbir özel araç bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir parçayı başka bir şeyin içine geçirerek onu delmek veya parçaları bu girişle birbirine bağlamaktır. Daha geniş kullanımında bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp birleştirmeyi de kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir uç ya da parça başka bir nesnenin içine girerek onu deler.
İçeri geçirme veya ekleme, iki şeyi birbirine bağlayıp bir arada tutar.
Kargıyla delme, iki yaprağı çubukla tutturma, balta gözünü daraltma ve kafes çubuklarını geçirme özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, kargı ucunun gövdeye girmesinden genel delme ve iki şeyi birbirine eklemeye uzanan ortak bir sokma-birleştirme alanı kurar. Araç ve nesne örnekleri bu ortak işlemin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

error_profile.preserves: İçeri girme, delme ve parçaları bir araya getirme işlemlerini korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Donanım adı ile donanımı kuşanmış kişi veya topluluk bildiren yapılar ayrı tutulur; gemlere ilişkin biçim yalın anlamın bütünü sayılmaz.

facets.statement: Savaş gereçleri kişinin üstüne giyilir veya kuşanılır.
Gereçleri eksiksiz kuşanan kişi veya demir donanımlı topluluk bu durumla nitelenir.
Gemler ve süvari donanımı aynı gereç alanına bağlı bir kullanım oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, kişinin üzerine giydiği savaş gereçleri ve bunları eksiksiz kuşanmış olma durumudur. Toplu kanıt ayrıca demir kuşanmış topluluğu ve gemleri bu donanım alanına bağlar.
